name: B-spline Wavelet Lifting Scheme
definition: A method to generate best approximations in a multiresolution hierarchy using B-spline wavelets, avoiding the over- and undershoots (and resulting topological changes in isosurfaces) caused by standard subdivision wavelets.
summary: The B-spline Wavelet Lifting Scheme generates multiresolution approximations using B-spline lifting to avoid the over- and undershoots that cause topological changes in isosurfaces with standard subdivision wavelets.
